QuestInfo.name: Raspberry Expression
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052121# says it's time for you to learn the raspberry expression. You need to give #b#t2001534#s#k to #p1032106# in #b#m101000000##k in order to learn it.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned the raspberry expression.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. You're getting more popular even without doing any shows...are you sure you don't want to sign? You'd be a superstar! Oh well, let's get to today's lesson, shall we?

yes.0: For our sixth class, you're learning the raspberry expression. Silly, rude, and cute, the raspberry expression is the heart of any good comedy routine here in Maple World.
yes.1: It's best to learn this expression from someone young. Go see #b#p1032106##k in #b#m101000000##k. He'll probably make a face at you if you give him #b300 #t2001534##k items. You should be able to buy them at general stores.

no.0: It's a little early to pick up a rock star attitude, don't you think?

npc.0: Have you learned the raspberry expression yet? Go see #p1032106#. He's in #m101000000#. Collect #b300 #t2001534#s#k and give them to #p1032106#.

item.0: What is it, human? I don't have any business with you.
